title: Karl Altstaetter
description: "When I first saw IG-88 (in THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK), I wondered what he was," recalls Karl Altstaetter. "Some android-turned-killer maybe. I was dying to see him in action. Fortunately I got my chance." Altstaetter is a writer-artist who got his break a few years back as an assistant at Homage Studios. Since then he has worked for Marvel, DC, Image, and most recently on his own project, Q-UNIT, for Harris Comics. In what little spare time he has he likes to play basketball and watch movies.
